Vendored copy of the mpc-autofill desktop tool (https://github.com/chilli-axe/mpc-autofill, desktop-tool/src),
GPL-3.0 licensed (see LICENSE.md), fetched from the master branch in September 2026 (matches the v4.7 release).
The files are unmodified; MC Autofill drives them from mc_autofill.py and reroutes their console prompts to the app UI.
To update: replace the files in src/ with the current desktop-tool/src/ from the repository.
